value.text: The source declares refreshExpired with a 60-second default fixed delay; scheduler registration and activation are unverified. It selects places with a null or expired forecast, ordered by place id, and passes each refresh call to a transaction callback inside a per-place try/catch. The shared refresh path returns on an unexpired cache entry. Fixture mode reads a place file; live mode requires a nonblank MET_USER_AGENT and uses a private in-memory ConcurrentHashMap field keyed by place id for nextAttempt, setting a 60-second deadline before the request. Each response sets expiry from Expires or a one-hour fallback, then sets nextAttempt from numeric Retry-After for 429 with a 60-second minimum, or from expiry for other statuses. A cached 304 updates expiry and returns. Fixture data and accepted 200/203 bodies share the transformation and persistence path: up to six periods require numeric temperature and a nonempty result; missing or nonnumeric rain becomes null and a missing symbol becomes unknown. The forecast upsert accepts an incoming updatedAt at least as new as the stored value, then attempts a forecast.updated outbox insert keyed by place id and updatedAt with conflict suppression. Pending-row delivery belongs to a separate linked publisher view. These source records do not prove scheduler activation, callback transaction behavior, or runtime delivery.
